entries.name: rent-fee-wrap-1718-true-fee-reject
entries.description: A 1718-byte box: storageFeeFactor * 1718 = 2147500000 overflows Int to -2147467296, so the JVM demands output 0 >= value + 2147467296. Output 0 keeps value - 2147500000 (the unwrapped fee): the JVM rejects, finally. 64-bit fee arithmetic accepts it.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. fe594059b79c26d234f31c837b06cf18f17e67998c1be7dc7016e71c5b653263: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-fee-wrap-1718-wrapped-fee-accept
entries.description: The same box recreated holding exactly value - (-2147467296) = value + 2147467296, funded by a second (scripted) input: the JVM's boundary, accepted. The rent input costs 50, the funding input its script.

entries.name: rent-fee-wrap-1718-wrapped-fee-minus-one-reject
entries.description: One nanoERG below the JVM's boundary: output 0 = value + 2147467295. Final reject.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 7d2a2d6227eae43bf2a22273b8a2909bc3405bb1a819ff5c963743509d349389: #0 => Success((false,50))

entries.name: rent-fee-wrap-3436-accept
entries.description: A 3436-byte box: storageFeeFactor * 3436 = 4295000000 wraps past 2^32 to 32704, so the JVM charges a 32704-nanoERG fee. Output 0 = value - 32704: exactly the JVM's boundary, accepted.

entries.name: rent-fee-wrap-3436-reject
entries.description: The same box with output 0 = value - 32705: one nanoERG below the wrapped fee's boundary. Final reject. With the unwrapped fee (4295000000) this output is far above the requirement.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. 751b4fd4f7bafd36c63ce2f2135abb82e305ae764564c6ee397f4459d163980c: #0 => Success((false,50))
